This is the best free android app for fbt I have seen. It was easy to set up, good at tracking where my legs were and my waist, but I would not recommend for dancing or anything with high moving. I bet the premium would be better after the 15 minutes but I was just testing this out so I dont want to waste my money. I usually use this for laughs and giggles or to sit and lay and stand. You can do high kicks too and its really fun. Thanks for making this!
